# abcGEO
> abcGEO publishes Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) frameworks, editorial, and interactive tools that help brands earn citations from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

abcGEO applies the proprietary formula **A + B = GEO**: pair a named Entity (A) with a transitive Verb (B) to produce unambiguous, machine-extractable facts.

## Primary entity
- Name: abcGEO
- Canonical site: https://abcgeo.dev/
- Category: Generative Engine Optimization / SEO subdivision
- Contact: hello@abcgeo.com

## Core framework
- [The A + B = GEO Framework](https://abcgeo.dev/framework.html): Entity + transitive action verb = citation-ready GEO output (includes Daikin HVAC case study)
- [Deep dive: Structuring content for LLM crawlers](https://abcgeo.dev/blog/the-a-plus-b-geo-framework.html): How NLP models extract subject–action–object triples
- [Case study: Daikin & A + B = GEO](https://abcgeo.dev/blog/daikin-a-plus-b-geo-case-study.html): How a $33B HVAC leader earned ChatGPT and Perplexity citations with entity infrastructure and transitive verbs

## Interactive tools
- [INSTASTACK](https://abcgeo.dev/tools/instastack.html): INSTASTACK generates standardized, machine-readable project stack configurations with embedded A + B = GEO metadata
